parameters.note: Sawmill Pond is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide regulation for inland lakes, reservoirs, and ponds in §5.85(a)(1).

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide regulation for lakes, reservoirs, and ponds; not listed as a special-regulation water)

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: General statewide trout limit for inland lakes, reservoirs, and ponds: five-trout daily bag limit and ten-trout possession limit.

candidates.summary: 5 trout daily bag limit, 10 trout possession limit

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license. In practice this pond is managed as a youth-only fishing area for children 14 and under (see the USFS access rule), so anglers there are below the license age.

candidates.summary: California sport fishing license required for anglers 16+

candidates.authorityName: USDA Forest Service — Lake Tahoe Basin Management Unit
candidates.citation: USFS LTBMU — Sawmill Pond Picnic Area

parameters.description: Sawmill Pond is managed by the USDA Forest Service (Lake Tahoe Basin Management Unit) as a stocked youth fishing area: only children 14 years of age and under may fish, and adults may help children fish but may not fish themselves.

raw.adults: may assist children but may not fish

candidates.summary: Youth fishing area: only children 14 and under may fish; adults may help but may not fish themselves

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Sawmill Pond (Region 2, El Dorado Co.) for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of May-September. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
